Reason: Blackman's Law of Limiting Factors: when multiple factors affect a process, the one at its minimum level limits the rate — relevant to crop yield management.

Reason: When water is scarce, ABA signals guard cells to close stomata, reducing CO₂ entry and limiting photosynthesis even when light is available.
